name: Accordion
looksLike: sections that expand when you click
stack of questions that reveal answers
rows with arrows that open more text underneath
definition: A stack of headings that expand or collapse their own content in place.
whenToUse: Optional details in a long page

notConfusedWith.difference: Switches between panels instead of expanding content under each heading.

prompts.short: Add an accordion with keyboard-operable headings that expand and collapse content.
prompts.detailed: Add an accordion using native details and summary elements. Let each section open independently. Give each summary a visible focus indicator and at least a 44px target; keep collapsed content out of keyboard navigation.

html: <summary style="min-height:44px; cursor:pointer">When will my order arrive?</summary>
Delivery takes three to five business days.
<summary style="min-height:44px; cursor:pointer">Can I return my order?</summary>
Unused items can be returned within 30 days.

a11yNotes: Use native details/summary or buttons with aria-expanded
Keep headings operable with Enter and Space
Keep collapsed content out of the tab order
